text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
ラミーヌ一家の皆様！
見回りご苦労様であります！
text.official_en: Hoy, House Lamine!

text.jp:
現在、この艦の出港のための整備を
進めているところであります！
text.official_en: Your ship is being readied but is not yet seaworthy.

text.jp: <#CTRL:0E>
text.official_en: It will be ready on the <#CTRL:0E>

text.jp:
あと、これは差し出がましいかもしれませんが……
海王ケートゥスは非常に危険な魔物です。
text.official_en:
I hope I'm not speaking out of turn here, but Cetus is
not like other creatures. It might be unstoppable.

text.jp:
出港するまでに、できる限りの準備を調えてから
港までお越しください！
text.official_en:
Please make careful preparations before heading to
the harbor.

text.jp:
一度出港してしまうとダグシオンには戻れません。
準備は入念にお願いします！
text.official_en:
Once you set sail, you won't be able to return to
Dagsion, so double-check your preparations.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
まあ、何はともあれ、
旅の支度を調える必要がありそうです。
text.official_en:
It seems it is time to make preparations for
our journey.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
今回は、かなりの長期間にわたり、
ダグシオンを離れることになりそうですし。
text.official_en:
We will be far from Dagsion, and we may not return
for some time.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ところで、海に出るならば、そのまま
フォドラに帰りたいとは思いませんか？
text.official_en:
As we will be traveling the seas, do you have a desire
to return to Fódlan after Cetus is slain?

text.jp: <NCA>思わなくもない
text.official_en: <NCA>Admit to fleeting thoughts of it.

text.jp: <NCB>そうでもない
text.official_en: <NCB>Deny the impulse.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees
post-choice branch reply retains the responder PID
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
<ACA>……そうなのですか？
私にとっては少々、意外ですね。
text.official_en: <ACA>Oh, indeed? That is something of a surprise to me.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees
post-choice branch reply retains the responder PID
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
<ACB>そう願いたいものです。私も、まだこの地で
やらねばならない事がありますし。
text.official_en:
<ACB>I should hope not. I too would remain in this land.
There is much to be done.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ファビオ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
ここと比べると、あの地は今の貴方にとり、
少し窮屈そうに思えたものですから。
text.official_en:
I suppose that, as compared to this land, you find the
mores of Fódlan quite restrictive.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
そういえば、この間ダーリンって
オルヘルと自分の妹の話をしてたよね。
text.official_en: I overheard you and Orchel talking about your sister.
text.real_en: I overheard you and Orhel talking about your sister.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
そのへん、あたいも興味あるんだ。
あたいが一人っ子だったからかも知れないけど。
text.official_en:
I'd like to know more about her. I'm an only child,
so I always wonder what it's like to have a sister.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
でも、大事な妹さんだったんじゃないの？
フォドラに一人で置いてきて大丈夫？
text.official_en:
You seem to care about her a lot. But you left her all
alone in Fódlan!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
え？　妹は強いから
何も心配いらないって？
text.official_en:
Oh, she's strong enough to take care of herself?
Well, OK!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_エスメラルダ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
……ダーリンからそこまで信用されるなんて、
本当に大した妹さんなんだねえ。
text.official_en: If you trust her, she must be special.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ミカエラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
正直いうと、あたしは船の上ってのは
どうも苦手なんだけど、文句は言わないよ。
text.official_en:
Ships aren't my favorite, but I'm not going
to complain.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ミカエラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
それに、出会ってこの方、
あんたには世話になりっぱなしだしね。
text.official_en: After all, since I first met you, I've been in your debt.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ミカエラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
相手が巨大な怪物だろうが上等さ。
腕の振るい甲斐があるってもんだよ。
text.official_en:
Giant monster? Bring it on! It'll be a nice way to
test myself.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ミカエラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
海の上でだって、この“鉄血のミカエラ”、
当てにしてもらって大丈夫だからね。
text.official_en: Be it land or sea, you can rely on Mikaela Redblade!
text.real_en: Be it land or sea, you can rely on Iron-Blooded Mikaela!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セテス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
噂を聞いた。
君が海に出て化け物退治をするのだと。
text.official_en:
I've heard the rumors. They say that you seek a
return to the sea—to slay a monster.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セテス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
だが、これを機に私の目から
逃れられるなどとは思わないことだ。
text.official_en:
But let me take this opportunity to say that you
will not escape my attention.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セテス
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
……正直なところ、海王ケートゥスとやらの
正体について、私も気掛かりではあるが……
text.official_en:
Though, frankly, I too wonder about this "Cetus,
the Sea Tyrant," and its true nature.
text.real_en:
Though, frankly, I too wonder about this "Cetus,
the Sea King," and its true nature.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
あ、あの……本当なんですか？
あの、海王ケートゥスに挑むだなんて……
text.official_en:
Tell me—it is not true, is it? You mean to challenge
Cetus, the Sea Tyrant?
text.real_en:
Tell me—it is not true, is it? You mean to challenge
Cetus, the Sea King?

text.jp:
それなら、アウロラ様の神殿で
航海の無事をお祈りしておかないと……
text.official_en:
If it is...I will make my way to the temple of Aurora
immediately and offer a prayer for your safety.

text.jp:
はい、これ。
あなたが無事に生きて戻れますように。
text.official_en: Take this token. May it bring you back unharmed.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
なあ、あんた、港はもう見たかい？
ダグザ大帝の軍艦だよ！
text.official_en:
Have you been down to the port? One of Dagda the
Great's warships is moored there!

text.jp:
たまげたよ。港にあんな立派な船が
保管されてたなんてなあ！
text.official_en:
I'm dumbfounded that they would leave a such a
historic ship just...just sitting there!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
黒いお兄ちゃん、
海王ケートゥスと戦うって本当？
text.official_en: I heard you're gonna fight Cetus! Is it true? Is it?
